+++ after/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
@@ -1,4 +1,16 @@
 # Architecture
+
+## Native spatial wet-paint replay — internal authoring dependency in verification
+
+`engine/wet-stroke.ts` prepares a complete recorded brush/pencil path independently of the viewport. Shared stamp spacing, pressure/tilt/tip geometry and original-first symmetry order feed native dabs; each symmetry copy retains a separate spatial Float32 pigment field. The previous tip basis multiplied by the inverse current basis transports that field through translation, rotation, reflection, shear and changing pressure. `wet-spatial.ts` gathers native bilinear neighbors by source tile, preserving a fixed per-pixel summation order across backing layouts. It never allocates a transformed source bounding rectangle. Absent neighbors outside the preceding native support are transparent; missing tiles within that support reject as incomplete state.
+
+Every dab reads the same previous canvas/reservoir epoch and stages all native tile results before advancing. Overlapping symmetry copies read preceding copies' completed dabs in the shared iterator order. Initial load uses the current native canvas under each copy. Fixed 256-pixel native coverage cells, with a two-pixel gutter, reuse actual Canvas footprint/texture sampling independently of the backing policy. Flow/pressure opacity applies during deposit/pickup; captured selection and whole-stroke opacity mix the completed original/result once. Unchanged pixels receive zero final blend coverage, preserving even hidden RGB outside the operation. Original/result tile pairs and binary changed-pixel support are prepared replacement data, not yet an authored operation or a live dependency on underlying layers.
+
+`wet-store.ts` owns a unique private IndexedDB job database. A bounded LRU retains working tiles; evictions preserve their backing records. Completed results own their original/result bytes until explicit asynchronous disposal. Cancellation, callback/processor/source/storage failures dispose the private job and publish no document command or assets. Web Locks protect active jobs across tabs/workers; the next preparation can delete unlocked abandoned job databases after their context terminates. Only the reserved UUID job namespace is eligible. Browsers without Web Locks or database enumeration retain explicit disposal but cannot automatically identify abandoned jobs; broader device/storage acceptance remains open. Cleanup failures surface, and preparation plus cleanup failures retain both causes.
+
+Trusted `prepareDocumentWetStroke` captures the requested rendered composition/branch, native source identities and font readiness before asynchronous sampling. It validates their lifetime/identity throughout, including source replacement under an unchanged asset ID. Its result can outlive source closure after all bytes are prepared. Preparation is read-only; a future selected-layer mutation adapter must choose the correct neutral content plane and preserve its own masks/opacity rather than baking rendered appearance twice. No new public DOM constructor, command, schema, script/plugin host service, REST endpoint, preset or UI tool is added by this internal dependency.
+
+Backing cells default to 128 pixels per side (internal policies permit 1–256), with a 32 MiB resident cache by default. Requests still use the numerical core's bounded working allocations; original image/document/stroke geometry remains independent. Unsafe integer pixel centers and noninvertible working bases fail explicitly. Metadata, native source/result/backing data, processing scratch and worker/WASM copies remain workload dependent. Full replay currently has no incremental gesture prefix, and these policies do not prove whole-process memory or interactive latency. Shared authored commands/history/assets, actual tools/previews/cancel/presets and persistence/native/SVG/GPU/automation publication remain unfinished.
 
 ## Wet paint simulation — internal dependency, authoring workflow unfinished

--- before/docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN.md
+++ after/docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN.md
@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
 # Canoli Studio System Design & Architecture Specification
+
+Native spatial wet preparation processes the complete recorded path before viewport cropping. Each symmetry copy owns a separate native spatial pigment field; copies sample completed preceding copies in shared dab order. Within one dab, all destination and carried reads use the same prior epoch. Complete private staging precedes advancement, and bilinear neighbors sum in a fixed order across backing partitions. Native coverage uses a fixed raster grid; final opacity/selection applies once and unchanged pixels remain byte-invariant. Disk-backed private jobs survive resident cache eviction, and active Web Locks prevent abandoned-job cleanup from deleting another tab/worker's state. Failed preparation publishes no model/assets and deletes its own namespace; completed output owns its bytes until disposal. The rendered-document sampler captures source/font identity and remains read-only. These are internal dependencies; authored ordered layer replacement, OO/history/persistence, tools/preview and export/automation integration remain unfinished. See ARCHITECTURE.md for defaults, bounds, cleanup fallback and current limits.
 
 Wet paint currently has an internal numerical dependency, not a shipped mixer/smudge workflow. Captured pre-dab destination and spatial carried pigment are distinct immutable inputs. The worker executes actual WASM premultiplied RGBA transport and returns owned RGBA8 pixels plus Float32 reservoir state. Pickup samples pre-deposit pixels; each dab tile therefore has no dependency on the processing order of other tiles from that same dab. Zero flow/coverage is inert; alpha can increase or decrease. Initial load is finite; whole-stroke selection/opacity belongs to a later original/result composite. Caller data never transfers, and returned extents/normalized premultiplied channels are validated. Bounded working tiles must not become source/document limits. Full-stroke spatial transport, ordered layer mutations, captured sources, UI/cancel/history/persistence and export parity remain required before delivery; no new isolated host service or REST/browser synchronization is added. See ARCHITECTURE.md for the exact internal equations and defaults.

scripts.seal.py:
import base64,difflib,hashlib,json,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
prefix='/tmp/canoli-brush-wet-spatial-';p=lambda suffix:Path(prefix+suffix)
base=Path('/tmp/canoli-brush-wet-spatial-baseline')
sha=lambda path:hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
subprocess.run(['python3',str(p('controller.py')),'verify'],check=True)
old=json.loads((base/'source-manifest.json').read_text());frozen=json.loads(p('frozen.json').read_text());changes={};before={}
for name,digest in old.items():
 if frozen[name]==digest:continue
 snapshot=base/name;assert sha(snapshot)==digest,name;before[name]=digest
 changes[name]=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(snapshot.read_text().splitlines(True),Path(name).read_text().splitlines(True),fromfile='before/'+name,tofile='after/'+name))
added={name:base64.b64encode(Path(name).read_bytes()).decode() for name in frozen if name not in old}
assert len(changes)==3 and len(added)==7,(len(changes),list(added))
unit=p('unit-final.log').read_text();assert '1314 passed' in unit and '163 passed' in unit
build=p('build-final.log').read_text();assert 'built in' in build
reports={}
for kind,count in [('browser',28),('production',78)]:
 captured=json.loads(p(kind+'-captured.json').read_text());stats=captured['report']['stats'];assert stats['expected']==count and stats['unexpected']==stats['flaky']==stats['skipped']==0
 assert len(captured['caseKeys'])==len(set(tuple(x) for x in captured['caseKeys']))==count
 assert json.loads(p(kind+'-exit.json').read_text())['exitCode']==0
 reports[kind]=captured
assert len(set(x[0] for x in reports['browser']['caseKeys']))==4
assert len([x for x in reports['browser']['caseKeys'] if Path(x[0]).name=='wet-spatial.e2e.ts'])==7
proof={}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='canoli-wet-paint-proof-') as temporary:
 root=Path(temporary)
 for name,digest in before.items():
  target=root/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes((base/name).read_bytes())
 patch=root/'changes.patch';patch.write_text(''.join(changes.values()));subprocess.run(['patch','-s','-p1','-i',str(patch)],cwd=root,check=True)
 for name,encoded in added.items():
  target=root/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(encoded))
 for name in set(changes)|set(added):
  proof[name]={'expected':frozen[name],'reconstructed':sha(root/name)};assert proof[name]['expected']==proof[name]['reconstructed'],name
p('reconstruction-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
